===== Contacts =====

  * Business licence, meals tax, business personal property (mailing address): Commissioner of the Revenue, PO Box 2964, Charlottesville, VA 22902
  * Commissioner of the Revenue: business tax: 434-970-3170
  * Commissioner of the Revenue: business tax email: [[citycorbiz@charlottesville.gov]]
  * Office of Neighborhood Development Services (zoning, home occupation, occupancy, mobile food unit permits): 434-970-3182
  * Blue Ridge Health District (food health permits): 434-972-6219
  * City Economic Development: business resources and programs: 434-825-0508
  * [[https://charlottesvilleva.govqa.us/WEBAPP/_rs/|City of Charlottesville online Records Request (GovQA) portal]]
  * City FOIA email (the 'Email Us' link on the FOIA Officers staff directory): [[FOIA@charlottesville.gov]]
  * FOIA & Records Officer (FOIA Officers directory main number): 434-970-3827
  * Mail, fax, or in-person FOIA requests: City Attorney's Office, P.O. Box 911, Charlottesville, VA 22902; fax 434-970-3890; phone 434-970-3131
  * [[https://www.charlottesville.gov/554/Freedom-of-Information-Act-FOIA|City FOIA hub page (rights, costs, responsibilities, exemptions)]]
  * Virginia FOIA Council (nonbinding advisory opinions); 804-225-3056 or toll-free 866-448-4100: [[foiacouncil@dls.virginia.gov]]
